scope: Official-reference metadata enrichment for the 135 Ultimate, Mega, Armor and No Level source sheets. No art, lore paragraphs, evolution edges or battle values are included.
authority: Bandai Digimon Encyclopedia, official English reference pages
method: Previously verified reference URLs were reused where names matched.
Other directory candidates were checked against actual official detail pages; failed guesses were corrected through the site's ordinary public name-search UI endpoint.
Queries used a temporary public session and the same AJAX header as the site UI; detail reads were paced. No login, challenge interaction or access-control bypass was used.
Only short factual fields were retained. SignatureSkillLabel is the first official Special Move label, not an asserted strongest or exclusive move.
Official names and stages are reference metadata. Source game stage, current RPG level, prototype battleType and authored damage rules remain separate.
Blank official fields are null. Ambiguous source labels retain multiple verified candidates and no single canonical identity until sheet review.

canonicalAliasGroups.policy: One canonical reference, two source sheet identities; visual variants not merged.
